title: Why the RBI is Hinting at Future Interest Rate Hikes
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) recently kept its main interest rate, the repo rate, unchanged at 5.25%. However, minutes from the latest meeting show top off.

faq.q: What is the RBI's inflation target?
faq.a: The RBI aims to keep retail inflation within a band of 2% to 6%, with a medium-term target of 4%.

faq.q: What caused the recent rise in inflation?
faq.a: The recent rise in inflation, particularly in July 2026 (4.45%), was mainly driven by higher food prices. Geopolitical tensions in West Asia also contribute to higher fuel prices.

faq.q: How often does the MPC meet?
faq.a: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) typically meets six times a year, every two months, to review the economic situation and decide on monetary policy.

faq.q: Will my existing fixed-rate home loan EMI increase?
faq.a: No, if you have a fixed-rate home loan, your EMI will not change. However, if you have a floating-rate loan, your EMI could increase if banks raise their lending rates in response to a repo rate hike.
